articles.title: 14-Year-Old Swimmer Zooms Past Records Like a Dolphin on Turbo Boost!
articles.summary: Lauren Lonsdale, 14, just swam the 400 IM in 4:44, making her the 4th-fastest girl her age EVER! She also won the 100 backstroke. Another 14-year-old, Natalia Lesniewska, tied for 10th all-time in the 100 free.

articles.title: A Secret Box for the Future: What Would YOU Put Inside?
articles.summary: To celebrate America's 250th birthday, a time capsule will be buried in Philadelphia until 2276. It holds wild stuff: a diamond from Arkansas, a whale bone from Maine, and an AI prediction from California!

articles.title: How a Surprise Duet Became the Biggest Song in U.K. History!
articles.summary: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's song "Rein Me In" has been No. 1 in the U.K. for 19 weeks—the longest ever! It started when Olivia joined Sam on stage at a huge concert, and fans went wild.
